warnings: This drawing set prints NO grid bubbles anywhere (structural or architectural) — only dimension chains. Labels were assigned here, following the precedent of house 122 (another unlabelled สพฐ. set): numbers 1-9 on the nine column lines along x (8 bays x 4.00 = 32.00, left to right as drawn), letters A-E on the column rows along y with A at the top of the plan as drawn. Origin A1 (top-left).

Rows: A (0.00) and E (10.00) carry the C1 perimeter columns; C (5.00) carries the interior C2 columns (left chain 5.00 / 5.00); B (3.25) and D (6.75) carry the end-wall C2 columns on grids 1 and 9 and the G4 beams across the toilet/store bay 5-6 (right chain 3.25 / 3.50 / 3.25). All five are column rows, so all five are named lines, not dummies.

The sheet-4 foundation plan (แบบแปลนฐานรากเข็มคอนกรีต, revised 2533) is the governing structural plan; the sheet-3 foundation plan is struck out (ยกเลิก) but prints the identical 4.00 x 8 / 5.00+5.00 / 3.25+3.50+3.25 chains — three plans agree on the grid.

Ridge-vent chain 0.90 / 1.25 / 1.25 / 0.90 (section ก-ก; left half also on truss A and on the gable elevation) is drawn centred on the ridge, i.e. on row C (the building is symmetric: 1.50 + 10.00 + 1.50, 2.50 + 10.00 + 2.50). Its ticks became dummies A''' 2.85, B' 3.75, C' 6.25, D' 7.15 (section 4 rule 4) and carry a per-line flag because the anchoring to C is by drawing position, not by a printed tick on C.

Before-origin y dummies share A's prime sequence (A' -2.50 eave, A'' -1.50 walkway, then A''' 2.85 in the A-B gap). x: 1' -1.00 and 9' 33.00 are the walkway/apron edges printed on the floor plan (1.00 beyond grids 1 and 9); the roof plan prints no x overhang (gable ends on grids 1 and 9).

z_levels: the only labelled levels are ระดับดินเดิม ±0.00 and the room/walkway tags +.40 / +.20; the others (+3.40, +4.40, +7.70, +8.70, -1.20) are positions on printed z chains with no label — ids are the computed level as text, type dummy.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets 3 and 4 (pages 04, 05) and the plan/section of sheet 1 (page 02). Sheet 2 (page 03, architectural details: windows, doors, wash basin, eave/vent details, blackboard) was not swept for ticks in this op04 run — its dimensions are element-internal detail sizes.
Scanned hand-lettered set (ปรับปรุง 2530, sheet 4 revised 2533); there are handwritten pen marks in the title blocks — ignored.
